title: The instrument itself: every check the mutation harness makes
note: Every claim that an enforcement point is load-bearing is produced by tools/mutation_matrix.py. If one of ITS checks stops working, the result is not a wrong number in a table -- it is an unprotected security check certified as protected. So the harness is mutated with its own machinery. The outer process has already imported the file, so mutating it on disk affects only the copy each test makes, which is exactly the subject under test. H4 is the sharpest: it reintroduces the stale-bytecode defect, under which a mutation's verdict describes code the harness did not write. H21 to H33 (AUD-093): a kill is a test's. An error in a test is a kill by that test; a mutant that does not load or cannot be collected under, a suite a signal ended and one that failed naming no test are not counted and fail the run; and a mutant reading a name nothing defines is refused unless it says why it never runs it.

mutations.name: H1_red_baseline_ignored
mutations.rationale: a matrix run against an already-failing suite reports every mutation as killed, for the pre-existing reason

mutations.name: H2_flaky_baseline_accepted
mutations.rationale: a baseline that can flake red can flake green, and a green flake reports kills nothing tested

mutations.name: H3_anchor_drift_becomes_a_skip
mutations.rationale: a mutation whose anchor no longer matches is silently skipped while still appearing in the report

mutations.name: H4_stale_bytecode_reused
mutations.rationale: a mutation runs against a cached module, so its verdict describes code the harness did not write

mutations.name: H5_bytecode_cache_shared_between_runs
mutations.rationale: a shared cache reintroduces cross-mutation contamination one level up

mutations.name: H6_specification_not_validated
mutations.rationale: a typo in a specification reaches the point where a source file has already been written to

mutations.name: H7_no_op_mutation_accepted
mutations.rationale: a mutation that changes nothing is reported as killed by whatever else the suite covers

mutations.name: H8_duplicate_names_accepted
mutations.rationale: a report naming a mutation no longer says which mutation it describes

mutations.name: H9_missing_mutation_fields_accepted
mutations.find: if not isinstance(m.get(field), str) or not m.get(field):
mutations.rationale: a specification missing 'find' crashes mid-loop on a tree already written to

mutations.name: H10_recovery_sidecar_ignored
mutations.rationale: a run starts on a tree a previous interrupted run may have left mutated, and reports results about it

mutations.name: H11_sources_not_restored
mutations.find:
(ROOT / path).write_text(src, encoding="utf-8")
                damaged = [f for f in _dirty_tracked_files()
mutations.rationale: a disabled safety guard is left on disk for whoever runs git add next

mutations.name: H12_post_run_baseline_not_checked
mutations.rationale: state a mutation left behind that the source hash cannot see is reported as a clean restoration

mutations.name: H13_survivors_do_not_fail_the_run
mutations.find:
return 0 if not (survived or anchors or timeouts or stillborn or signalled
                     or unnamed or drifted or collateral or still_dirty
                     or post.rc) else 1
mutations.rationale: an unprotected enforcement point exits green, so CI never sees it

mutations.name: H14_survived_reported_as_killed
mutations.rationale: every mutation is reported killed regardless of what the suite did

mutations.name: H15_collateral_damage_discarded_without_a_copy
mutations.rationale: the harness reverts a tracked file with git checkout and keeps nothing; an uncommitted edit made while it runs is indistinguishable from damage and is lost

mutations.name: H16_collateral_damage_not_restored
mutations.rationale: a file a mutated build corrupted stays corrupted, so every later mutation runs against damaged inputs and the report says nothing

mutations.name: H17_a_timeout_only_kill_is_counted_as_coverage
mutations.find: killed = sum(1 for v in results.values() if v == "KILLED")
mutations.replace:
killed = sum(1 for v in results.values()
                 if v in ("KILLED", "KILLED_BY_TIMEOUT"))
mutations.rationale: restores what this counted before: a mutation nothing bounds appears in the score as coverage while saying nothing about which check was lost, and costs the whole suite timeout on every run

mutations.name: H18_a_timeout_only_kill_does_not_fail_the_run
mutations.rationale: the harness reports the condition and passes anyway, which is what let two timeout-only kills sit in the specs until somebody read the report closely

mutations.name: H19_a_post_run_failure_is_always_called_residue
mutations.find:
recheck = run_suite(suites, args.python, only=post.named)
        if recheck.rc == 0:
mutations.replace:
recheck = run_suite(suites, args.python, only=post.named)
        if False:
mutations.rationale: D-2026-34: a nondeterministic test produces the same signature as leftover state, and the harness names the one it cannot establish

mutations.name: H_NC1_the_null_control_runs_without_a_sidecar
mutations.rationale: D-2026-82: a hard kill during the null control leaves an edited target and nothing for --recover to restore it from

mutations.name: H_NC2_the_stop_handler_is_not_installed
mutations.rationale: D-2026-82: a SIGTERM during the null control or a mutation leaves the edited target in place

mutations.name: H20_the_same_mutant_counted_twice
mutations.rationale: AUD-087: two entries making one mutant are both run, and the matrix counts one fault twice and a second fault covered that is the first

mutations.name: H21_an_error_in_a_test_is_no_test
mutations.rationale: a test that errors, in its setup or its body, is reported as no test at all, the line a mutant nothing ran against gets (AUD-093)

mutations.name: H22_a_suite_not_collected_is_a_kill
mutations.rationale: a mutant the suites cannot be collected under is counted as killed, though no test ran (AUD-093)

mutations.name: H23_the_load_check_is_not_asked
mutations.find:
if path in loadable:
                    problem = load_problem(path, args.python)
mutations.rationale: a module that does not load is killed by whichever test imports it first, and the kill names that test (AUD-093)

mutations.name: H24_a_stillborn_mutant_is_counted
mutations.find: killed = sum(1 for v in results.values() if v == "KILLED")
mutations.replace: killed = sum(1 for v in results.values() if v in ("KILLED", "STILLBORN"))
mutations.rationale: a mutant no test ran against is counted as coverage (AUD-093)

mutations.name: H25_a_stillborn_mutant_does_not_fail_the_run
mutations.rationale: the run passes with a mutant no test ran against (AUD-093)

mutations.name: H26_a_signal_is_read_as_no_verdict
mutations.rationale: a suite a signal ended is reported as one that named no test, and the signal goes unsaid (AUD-093)

mutations.name: H27_a_signal_kill_is_counted
mutations.rationale: a suite a signal ended is counted as a kill, though no test said which check was lost (AUD-093)

mutations.name: H28_a_signal_kill_does_not_fail_the_run
mutations.find:
or stillborn or signalled
                     or unnamed
mutations.rationale: the run passes with a mutant only a signal ended (AUD-093)

mutations.name: H29_no_verdict_is_a_kill
mutations.rationale: a suite that failed naming no test is counted as a kill (AUD-093)

mutations.name: H30_no_verdict_does_not_fail_the_run
mutations.rationale: the run passes with a mutant nothing named a verdict on (AUD-093)

mutations.name: H31_a_name_nothing_defines_is_run
mutations.find: if added and why is None:
mutations.rationale: a mutant that raises NameError where its fault was to act is run, and its crash is counted as a kill (AUD-093)

mutations.name: H32_a_reason_for_an_unbound_name_is_believed
mutations.find: elif added is not None and not added and why is not None:
mutations.rationale: an entry may say its mutant never runs a name it does not read, and the reason outlives the mutant it described (AUD-093)

mutations.name: H33_a_name_read_in_a_function_is_not_seen
mutations.rationale: a name nothing defines, read inside a function, is not seen, and that is where every such mutant reads it (AUD-093)

mutations.name: H34_the_load_check_shares_bytecode
mutations.rationale: the load check of one mutant reads the bytecode another left, and answers for code the harness did not write (AUD-093)

mutations.name: H35_the_load_check_keeps_the_callers_bytecode_prefix
mutations.rationale: the load check compiles where its caller does, so a cached module of the same size and second answers for the mutant (AUD-093)
